episodes.name: The Volcano
episodes.overview: A criminal named Jwala, plans on erupting a volcano, and Shiva unearths the bomb placed to blast the volcano into being active. Will he manage to prevent a disaster?

episodes.name: Twister Thief
episodes.overview: A city faces a destructive twister, but the truth is far more sinister. A criminal, Tornado, is using it to rob banks. Only Shiva can stop him.

episodes.name: The Plane Hijack
episodes.overview: Sheru, a thief, is caught stealing a car. His gang hijacks a plane, demanding his release. Shiva, a hero, intervenes to stop them.

episodes.name: The Train Without A Driver
episodes.overview: A runaway train carrying flammable oil threatens disaster. Shiva and his friends race against time to stop it.

episodes.name: Inter-School Cycle Race
episodes.overview: Shiva faces sabotage from last year's champion, Rocky, in the inter-school cycling competition. Will he overcome the obstacles and claim victory?

episodes.name: Gold In The Dam
episodes.overview: Shiva suspects men stealing soil from Vedas river. Doctor Bang reveals the soil's hidden gold. Shiva dives in to stop Bang's smuggling.

episodes.name: Bus Out Of Control
episodes.overview: Shiva learns that his friend Rewa is in danger, after the bus she was travelling in, lost its balance. Will Shiva be able to calm this giant and rescue the passengers?

episodes.name: Shiva Vs Electro Man
episodes.overview: Robberies plague Vedas City, fueling fear. Shiva and his friends investigate, leading them to a face-off with the Electro Man gang.

episodes.name: Shiva Meets Airawat
episodes.overview: Shiva rescues a girl from a rampaging elephant, Airawat. But hunters are on his trail. Can he outsmart them and stay hidden?

episodes.name: Mystery Of The Missing Diamonds
episodes.overview: A mysterious boat by the diamond warehouse piques Shiva's curiosity, leading him to uncover a daring theft.

episodes.name: The Ghost Of Vedas City
episodes.overview: A bodybuilder tyrant threatens Vedas City, using a ghost created by his scientist accomplice. Shiva and his allies must expose the truth to save their city.

episodes.name: Mystery Of The Missing Statues
episodes.overview: When Chinkara's gang steals precious statues, Shiva and his friends embark on a thrilling chase to reclaim them.

episodes.name: The Mystery Of The Sea Monster
episodes.overview: A beach picnic turns terrifying when Shiva and his friends face a monstrous sea creature. He saves them, but the mystery deepens. Can he solve it?

episodes.name: Water Trouble
episodes.overview: Shiva exposes Veerpani's water scam, but Veerpani retaliates by kidnapping Shiva's friends and the police. Shiva must rescue them and bring Veerpani to justice.

episodes.name: The Roboman
episodes.overview: Dr. No plots to unleash deadly gas on Vedas city, but Shiva's supernatural powers thwart the plan and bring the villain to justice.

episodes.name: The Hostages
episodes.overview: Sher Singh, a ruthless criminal, kidnaps school children after a botched bank robbery. Shiva, a brave hero, tracks him down and confronts him in a thrilling showdown.

episodes.name: Shiva Vs The Joker
episodes.overview: Shiva and his friends witness a jewelry store robbery by the Joker. They report it to Inspector Ladoo Singh, leading to the culprit's arrest.

episodes.name: My Friend Dolphin
episodes.overview: Shiva and his friends save an injured dolphin from poachers, but they steal it to make money. Can Shiva rescue the dolphin and return it to the sea?

episodes.name: Shiva Vs Cycle Chor
episodes.overview: Veda city's cycles are stolen by a ruthless gang. When the police fail, Shiva steps up, setting a trap to reclaim the stolen goods and bring the thieves to justice.

episodes.name: The Jet Pack Gang
episodes.overview: Shiva fights to rescue Reva from the Jet Pack Gang's theft. After escaping their capture, he brings them to justice.

episodes.name: Smoky Man
episodes.overview: Akalmand's invention, Smoky Man, goes rogue. Shiva must stop the army's dangerous creation.

episodes.name: Pocket Mar Dancer
episodes.overview: During a Pocket Mar Dancers performance, a thief targets the crowd. Shiva's pursuit fails, but he recovers a jacket, leading to Kancha's capture and surrender to Ladoo Singh.

episodes.name: Amusement Park
episodes.overview: Ladoo Singh pursues Jagga, a mugger terrorizing the amusement park. When Jagga sabotages the Ferris wheel, Shiva steps in to save the day.

episodes.name: Nakli Santa Claus
episodes.overview: Prison break! Daya escapes, aided by accomplices. Ladoo & Shiva pursue. Will Daya avenge his capture?

episodes.name: Shiva Vs Mahabali
episodes.overview: Fake medicine turns a Vedas citizen into the destructive Mahabali. Shiva arrives to quell the chaos and restore him.

episodes.name: Baby Chimpanzee
episodes.overview: Illegal lab turns chimps human. Shiva & Singh save the apes, reunite a baby chimp.

episodes.name: Bahrupiya Lutera
episodes.overview: When robberies start taking place all over the city, Shiva takes it upon himself to catch the culprit. Will the the thief outsmart Shiva?

episodes.name: Bull's Attack
episodes.overview: A rampaging bull wreaks havoc at the market. Vedas' Police Inspector, Mr. Ladoo Singh, is helpless. Can Shiva save the day?

episodes.name: Chor Langoor
episodes.overview: A thief and his langoor, Tinku, plot to rob the city. Shiva suspects Tinku and investigates, leading to the thief's capture with Ladoo Singh's help.

episodes.name: Kaviraj Lutera
episodes.overview: Shiva and Ladoo Singh race against time to defuse bombs planted in Vedas. They must solve riddles left by the mastermind, Kaviraj Lutera. Will he escape justice?

episodes.name: Jack The Thief
episodes.overview: Shiva tries to trace a bank robber, but fails in his first attempt. Later, he works out a meticulous plan with Ladoo Singh and his friends, and nabs the thief.

episodes.name: The Animal Train
episodes.overview: A train filled with exotic animals is hijacked by Shabaash Singh and his gang. Adi, Udi, and Reva are trapped. Shiva must save the animals and his friends.

episodes.name: Finding Nana Ji
episodes.overview: Shiva's grandfather is kidnapped by Nana Bhavani Shankar. He must rescue him and stop the sandalwood smuggler's reign of terror.

episodes.name: The Cycle Gang
episodes.overview: Shiva must take part in a cycle stunt competition and prove his worth if he wants the cycle gang to stop troubling his friends. How will Shiva fair in the competition?

episodes.name: Shiva - Toofan
episodes.overview: Shiva races his rescued horse, Toofan, against the ruthless Raftaar Singh. Will friendship win?

episodes.name: The Wicked Angel
episodes.overview: Veda City gets a tempting offer. Shiva's doubt could save them all. JioHotstar.

episodes.name: The Dancing Thief
episodes.overview: A dancing thief's double-crossed Ladoo & Shiva. Will they catch him on his third try?

episodes.name: The Criminals List
episodes.overview: Kidnapped while retrieving a criminal list, Shiva saves the day, stopping the theft and rescuing his friends.

episodes.name: Haunted Car
episodes.overview: An elderly man reports a car robbery to the police, claiming the vehicle was driven by a ghost. Is his fear justified?
